t: For an additional amount for “Government payment for annuitants, employee life insurance”, $9,000,000 to remain available until expended.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation of additional funds for annuitant life insurance payments. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Government payment for annuitants, employee life insurance”, $9,000,000 to remain available until expended.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing the expenditure of funds for government payments. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Government payment for annuitants, employee life insurance”, $9,000,000 to remain available until expended.

opus.w: This section only provides $9,000,000 for government payments for annuitants' employee life insurance. It describes no process that brings anyone outside the federal government into a federal decision. Seeing the word "Government" in the account title is not a reason to treat this as participation.
opus.b: The only possible temptation is the word "Government" in the appropriation heading. It has nothing to do with outside parties taking part in a decision. This is a plain appropriation line. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: This section is an appropriation clause authorizing funds for government payments to annuitants and employees. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. The definition explicitly excludes applications for benefits, and this text merely allocates money for such payments without establishing a participatory mechanism.
qwen_chat.s: For an additional amount for “Government payment for annuitants, employee life insurance”, $9,000,000 to remain available until expended.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "annuitants" and "employees" are outside the federal government and that the payment constitutes a form of participation or benefit application. However, the definition explicitly excludes "applications for benefits or grants." Furthermore, this text is a simple appropriation clause authorizing funds for payments; it does not establish a process for consultation, coordination, or decision-making involving these individuals. It is purely a funding authorization.
